column1: # Ground-truth labels for findings on the §17 OSS validation set. `fp`/`tp`
# are ground truth; `info-expected` is ground truth for a finding that is only
# correct at info severity; `deferred` records heuristic triage that still
# Tab-separated columns (lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored):
#   code          CHK001 | CHK002 | CHK003 | CHK004 | CHK006 | CHK010
#   target        stable JSON target field (was distribution for dep rules)
#   bucket        root-cause bucket for CHK003 fp, info-expected or deferred,
#                 and for fp of the sampled rules; use - otherwise
#   note          short justification (how it was verified)
# scripts/oss-metrics.py matches findings on (slug, code, target); one row per
# key. Unlabeled findings are unknown; unknown and deferred block CHK002 FP gate.
# Info-severity findings are not hits: they never count as fp/tp, and an
# `info-expected` label on a finding reported above info counts as fp.
# CHK001 / CHK004 / CHK006 / CHK010 carry a stratified sample (section at the
# end, drawn by scripts/sample-precision-labels.py) to record per-rule
# precision; CHK004 rows above it are recall sentinels.
